summary_en: MAX acquired 698,600 treasury shares from subsidiary Fuji Kogyo K.K. for 1.33 billion yen on September 18, 2026, representing 0.4% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The acquisition was conducted via direct transaction at the September 11 closing price of 1,899 yen per share, as required under the Corporate Law.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock from Subsidiary under Article 163 of the Companies Act
translation_en_brief: On September 14, 2026, MAX's Board of Directors resolved to acquire 698,600 treasury shares held by its subsidiary Fuji Kogyo K.K. The acquisition was executed via direct transaction on September 14, with settlement on September 18, 2026. The total consideration was 1.33 billion yen, calculated at the September 11 Tokyo Stock Exchange closing price of 1,899 yen per share. The acquired shares represent 0.4% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock as of August 31, 2026). This acquisition is mandated under Article 135, paragraph 3 of the Companies Act, which requires companies to acquire shares of themselves held by subsidiaries. Fuji Kogyo K.K., the selling subsidiary, is located in Fujiaoka, Gunma and engages in manufacturing components for construction tools, medical devices, and satellites.
